fullval_runs_fullval_authorized_1h_01.version: authorized_fullval_1h_v1 (old eval-derivation gold; cost audit unaffected by gold version)

formal_campaign_proposed_state_increment.version: formal_launch_v1 (old gold; DIAGNOSTIC; killed mid 9th cell; the 8 completed cells are used; the interrupted cell has no evaluation record and is excluded — its spend lives in the campaign journal, not in these copies)

conventions.coverage_upper: fraction of cells with actual <= prediction (prediction treated as candidate upper bound)
conventions.coverage_lower: fraction of cells with actual >= prediction
conventions.token_scale: the predictor outputs a PER-TASK MEAN; ledger new_tokens is the CELL TOTAL over n tasks. Both scales are reported: per_task (pred vs actual/n) and cell_total (pred*n vs actual). v1 of this audit compared per-task prediction against cell-total actual — an 8x scale artifact that masqueraded as systematic underestimation; corrected here.
conventions.separation: deployment C and search physical spend NEVER merged
conventions.oracle: same identity rules, single shared scope per run — isolates scope-split conservatism from identity-rule error

sources_note: frozen copies only; random cell (no terminal record) and all running sessions excluded

node_level_predictor.note: false_hit = predicted cache hit but ledger shows a new request — the unsafe direction for budget; must be 0 for precision-1.0 claim
